article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Texas -- — Jaxson Thompson scored 32 points, including a game-winning shot from beyond halfcourt as Rice took down Stephen F. Austin 81-78 in overtime on Saturday. Thompson had five assists for the Owls (2-2). Jimmy Oladokun Jr. scored 14 points and added nine rebounds. Carmelo Adkins shot 4 for 12 (2 for 6 from 3-point range) and 2 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Erik Makke finished with 18 points for the Lumberjacks (3-1). Marcus Scurry added 13 points. Gediminas Alisas finished with nine points and six assists. Up next Rice's next game is Tuesday against Texas A&M-CC at home. Stephen F. Austin takes on Indiana State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
